description: This source file defines an Android activity called ShadowCardStack that creates and animates a stack of card views with various transformations such as translation, rotation, and Z-ordering to produce a visual stacking and floating effect. The class includes methods for setting up complex animation sequences and a listener for repeating the animation loop.

classes.name: ShadowCardStack
classes.description: An Android activity that creates a stack of animated cards with various transformations.

classes.name: RepeatListener
classes.description: An internal class implementing Animator.AnimatorListener to facilitate repeating the animation sequence.

methods.name: createSet
methods.description: Creates an AnimatorSet that plays a list of animations together with a specified start delay.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the views and constructs the animation sequences for the card stack.
